svg.title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Pipeline
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Pipeline; subtitle: Build a working operation without compressing statutory calendars.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Sprint days are calendar-day project milestones; statutory business-day and calendar-day clocks remain separate. The canonical first-deal horizon is 1–4 months, and this sprint does not assume a completed award, payer deposit, or earned contingency within 30 days.; caption: End the month with authorized intake, defensible routing, tested timers, and claim-level economics. Advance individual cases only when their actual statutory and operational conditions hold.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Authority and data foundation; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Execute provider engagement and required BAA documents; define the incremental-cash fee formula and fee ownership. Configure least-privilege access and reconcile a sample 835 to bank receipts. Deliver an intake checklist and a tested initial-payment ledger.; label: Days 8-14; value: Routing and clock validation; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Classify a pilot cohort using plan documents, service facts, and state-law applicability. Test holiday handling, 30-business-day negotiation calculations, four-business-day initiation windows, and cooling-off restrictions. Deliver a dated routing record for every pilot claim.; label: Days 15-21; value: Evidence and negotiation execution; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Start eligible open negotiations within their actual deadlines, retain delivery evidence, and prepare supported offers. Test packet generation with clinical source links and prohibited-benchmark checks. Older eligible matters may advance only if their own clocks permit.; label: Days 22-30; value: Cash controls and capacity decision; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile pilot status, fee exposure, available liquidity, and contractor capacity. Test contingency calculations against partial collections, losses, and confirmed refunds. Deliver a cash forecast and next-month case schedule; record pending negotiations without fabricating awards or collections.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Pipeline
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Controlled Recovery Pipeline

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Authority and data foundation; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Execute provider engagement and required BAA documents; define the incremental-cash fee formula and fee ownership. Configure least-privilege access and reconcile a sample 835 to bank receipts. Deliver an intake checklist and a tested initial-payment ledger.

label: Days 8-14; value: Routing and clock validation; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Classify a pilot cohort using plan documents, service facts, and state-law applicability. Test holiday handling, 30-business-day negotiation calculations, four-business-day initiation windows, and cooling-off restrictions. Deliver a dated routing record for every pilot claim.

label: Days 15-21; value: Evidence and negotiation execution; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Start eligible open negotiations within their actual deadlines, retain delivery evidence, and prepare supported offers. Test packet generation with clinical source links and prohibited-benchmark checks. Older eligible matters may advance only if their own clocks permit.

label: Days 22-30; value: Cash controls and capacity decision; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile pilot status, fee exposure, available liquidity, and contractor capacity. Test contingency calculations against partial collections, losses, and confirmed refunds. Deliver a cash forecast and next-month case schedule; record pending negotiations without fabricating awards or collections.

text.title: Assumptions: Sprint days are calendar-day project milestones; statutory business-day and calendar-day clocks remain separate. The canonical first-deal horizon is 1–4 months, and this sprint does not assume a completed award, payer deposit, or earned contingency within 30 days.
